new_insert_email_body.title: Urgent: Vendor Security Review — May 30, 2:00–3:00 PM
new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

I have a vendor security review that needs a time slot. Could you check whether May 30, 2024 from 2:00 to 3:00 PM is clear on your calendar? Thanks,
Mark
